name: Eevee

abilities.name: run-away
abilities.effect: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.

abilities.name: adaptability
abilities.effect: Increases the same-type attack bonus from 1.5× to 2×.

abilities.name: anticipation
abilities.effect: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, self destruct, explosion, or a one-hit KO move.

genderDifference: Female's tail's white tip has larger, rounder scallops. This gender difference was introduced in Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!, where it was exclusive to the partner Pokémon Eevee. Starting in Generation VIII, this gender difference was applied to all Eevee.

kanto.flavorText: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONES.

original-johto.flavorText: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

hoenn.flavorText: An EEVEE has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to its environment. Radiation from various STONES causes this POKéMON to evolve.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.

updated-johto.flavorText: Its irregularly configured DNA is affected by its surroundings. It evolves if its environment changes.

original-unova.flavorText: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.

updated-unova.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

kalos.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to the environment in which it lives. Radiation from various stones causes this Pokémon to evolve.

original-alola.flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

updated-alola.flavorText: Its genes are easily influenced by its surroundings. Even its face starts to look like that of its Trainer.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: It can evolve into a variety of forms. Eevee’s genes are the key to solving the mysteries of Pokémon evolution.

swsh.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

freeTextEntries: Received from Bebe in Hearthome City | Trophy Garden

pla.flavorText: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.
